raw_articles.title: Presentation: From S3 to GPU in One Copy: Rethinking Data Loading for ML Training
raw_articles.summary: Onur Satici explains how Vortex, an open-source columnar file format under the Linux Foundation, revolutionizes high-throughput data loading. By Onur Satici
